title: Strict functoriality of concrete Godement mapping fibres
statement: For every commutative ring $A$ and finitely generated ideal $I\subset A$, use the actual augmented Godement mapping fibre $(K(A,I),\epsilon_{A,I})$ of [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-godement-construction]. There is a family of degreewise $\varphi$-semilinear maps $m_\varphi:K(A,I)\to K(B,J)$ for every ring map $\varphi:A\to B$ and every equality $\varphi(I)B=J$ of finitely generated ideals, satisfying the predicate $\operatorname{RingComplexFunctorial}$ of [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data]. Explicitly, these commute with the differentials, satisfy $\epsilon_{B,J}m_\varphi=\varphi\epsilon_{A,I}$, are identity for $\varphi=\mathrm{id}_A$ and every equality witness for $I\mathrm{id}_A=I$, and satisfy $m_\psi m_\varphi=m_{\psi\varphi}$ for every pair of composable ring maps and every supplied ideal-extension equality. This statement asserts no Cech comparison or derived base change.

proof.text: The inverse-image prime avoids I exactly when the prime avoids I B. Restrict Spec(phi) to a morphism of open complements U(B,J) to U(A,I). The coefficient map is the induced map of their structure modules.

Apply the proved strict Godement model-map family to the induced map of open complements and the structure-module coefficient map. It supplies both cosimplicial maps and extended cochain maps with identity, composition and actual germ-augmentation equations. Take global sections, restricting coefficients along the ring maps from A and B. This gives the differential-compatible semilinear maps on the Godement section complexes.

Together with phi in degree zero the section maps form a square of the restriction cochain maps. Apply the functorial mapping cone and inverse rotation. Projection gives the augmentation equation. For identity morphisms every coordinate is unchanged. For a composite, both formulas select the coordinate at the composite image and apply the composite stalk map, so they agree. Extension equalities for ideals and all equality transports have proof-irrelevant witnesses. This gives all four equations, including empty complements. Form the square in A-modules by restriction of scalars from B. Restriction of scalars preserves finite biproducts and shifts, so the cone map and inverse rotation identify its target with the restricted B mapping fibre. Its section maps are therefore semilinear. The restriction coherences are the identity on underlying section functions, which gives the strict equations there.
